title: Upstream Exploration Analytics
thesis: Snowflake unifies seismic, well, and production data across 8 offshore blocks — ML.FORECAST models decline curves, Cortex Search surfaces subsurface reports, and Iceberg sharing gives JV partners governed access without data copies

talking_points: Two hundred wells across 8 Production Sharing Contract blocks in the Malay and Sarawak Basins.
RM 4.2 billion annual production revenue — but 3 blocks showing accelerated decline.
Three new prospects identified above economic threshold this quarter.
show: Point at the RM 4.2B revenue KPI card
Highlight the 8 blocks on the map
tabs.call_out: RM 4.2B revenue — 3 new prospects above economic threshold

transition.line: Let's drill into the production performance and decline curves.

talking_points: Well MY-047 in Block PM-3 showing 18% annual decline — faster than type curve prediction.
ML.FORECAST projects 12-month production trajectory for each well with confidence intervals.
Water cut increasing in 4 mature wells — candidates for workover or shut-in decision.
show: Click Well MY-047 in the well list
Show the decline curve with ML forecast overlay
tabs.call_out: ML.FORECAST projects 200 decline curves — 4 wells need intervention

transition.line: The decline is real. Let's check the subsurface data.

talking_points: One hundred and twenty subsurface documents — well proposals, seismic interpretations, geological assessments.
Cortex Search surfaces relevant reports instantly for prospect evaluation.
AI classifies documents by prospect maturity: Discovery, Appraisal, Development-ready.
tabs.call_out: 120 subsurface docs searchable — AI classifies by prospect maturity

transition.line: Now let the VP ask the system directly.

talking_points: Dr. Kamal asks: 'Which prospects exceed our economic threshold?'
Cortex Analyst writes the query, returns 3 prospects with NPV above RM 800M.
Switch to advisor: 'What does the subsurface report say about Prospect Alpha?' — searches docs and summarises.
show: Type: 'Which prospects exceed our economic threshold?'
tabs.call_out: Two AI modes: SQL analytics + subsurface advisory

transition.line: Every capability — native Snowflake SQL, open Iceberg for JV partners.

talking_points: Six Snowflake capabilities, six AWS services.
Iceberg tables give JV partners governed access without data copies.
Malaysia's O&G sector: 600,000 bbl/d production. This monitors 200 wells across 8 blocks.
tabs.call_out: One platform, native ML, open Iceberg for JV partner access

transition.line: That's Snowflake and AWS — better together for upstream exploration.
